paragraphs.text: Sam is a young scientist. He lives on a big space station. The station goes around the Earth.
paragraphs.translation: 萨姆是一位小科学家。他住在一个很大的太空站上。太空站绕着地球飞行。

paragraphs.text: Every morning Sam looks out of the window. He can see the blue Earth and many stars. Next week he will visit the Moon.
paragraphs.translation: 每天早上，萨姆都会望向窗外。他能看见蓝色的地球和许多星星。下周他要去月球。

paragraphs.text: How will he go there? A space train will take him. It is very fast and very clean.
paragraphs.translation: 他怎么去那儿呢？一列太空列车会送他去。它非常快，也非常干净。

paragraphs.text: The space train is fun. But you must follow some rules. You must wear a seat belt. You should keep your bag under the seat. You should not run in the train.
paragraphs.translation: 太空列车很好玩。但你必须遵守一些规则。你必须系好安全带。你应该把包放在座位下面。你不该在列车里跑来跑去。

paragraphs.text: Sam will do a science test on the Moon. He must take his small robot with him. The robot will help him find rocks. Maybe they could find water there. That could be a big surprise!
paragraphs.translation: 萨姆要在月球上做一次科学测试。他必须带上他的小机器人。机器人会帮他找石头。也许他们能在那里找到水。那可真是个大大的惊喜！

paragraphs.text: Sam is excited about his trip. He will be a great scientist one day. What will you do in space?
paragraphs.translation: 萨姆对这次旅行特别兴奋。总有一天他会成为一位了不起的科学家。那你会在太空里做什么呢？
